summary: Add standard export (PDF/zip) for Compliance Reporting Pack v1 for Sales/SE distribution (with access controls)
description:
Requester: Sales/Solutions Engineering

Context
- Multiple ongoing enterprise security reviews are requesting a "compliance report" package that can be shared quickly (PDF + supporting attachments).
- We have the Compliance Reporting Pack v1 content in Confluence and draft artifacts, but we do not currently have a standardized, access-controlled export format that Sales/SE can self-serve.

Request
- Provide a standard export bundle (PDF and/or zip) of the Compliance Reporting Pack v1 that Sales/SE can download and share with prospects/customers.
- The export must be access controlled and auditable (who generated/downloaded, for which tenant/account, when).

Intended users
- Solutions Engineering (SE)
- Sales Engineering / Security Specialists
- GRC (for maintenance)

Requirements / Acceptance Criteria
1) Export formats
   - One-click download of a single PDF (customer-facing) AND a zip bundle option.
   - Zip should include: PDF + control-to-evidence matrix (sanitized) + retention policy attestation page + audit log coverage summary.
   - Each artifact should include metadata (generated_at, version, redaction level, intended audience) embedded in the PDF footer or first page.

2) Access controls
   - Only available to Redwood internal users.
   - RBAC: limit to approved internal roles/groups (initial proposal: Solutions Engineering + Sales leadership + Security & Compliance).
   - Block external sharing links; exports must require Redwood SSO.

3) Auditability
   - Log events for: export generated, export downloaded, export generation failed.
   - Events should be discoverable by Security/Compliance (for evidence + incident response).

4) Distribution safety
   - Export must be "tenant-neutral" by default (no customer identifiers, no internal-only URLs).
   - Optional: allow user to select a target prospect/customer name to watermark the PDF (e.g., "Prepared for <Company>") without embedding internal deal notes.

5) Versioning + maintenance
   - The export should be generated from a pinned "Compliance Reporting Pack v1" template.
   - Include version string (e.g., CRP-v1.0) and revision date.
   - Document the update cadence and owner process.

Out of scope (for this ticket)
- Automatically attaching exports to HubSpot records.
- Custom per-customer tailored reports beyond watermarking.

Notes
- This ticket is an internal support/workflow request; Engineering implementation work may be tracked in ENG-2940 or a new Console/Docs issue.

Impact
- Reduces turnaround time for enterprise security reviews (currently manual compilation via GRC).
- Avoids inconsistent/incorrect artifacts being shared.

Proposed owner(s)
- Primary: Daniel Carter (Compliance pack execution)
- Consulted: Olga Petrov (GRC), Chloe Martin/Jada Williams (Console), Marcus Lin (Security Eng), Elliot Price (Docs)

Target timeline
- Initial self-serve export for SE teams within ~2 weeks to unblock active reviews (Prospect A/B).
